Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
The text of Vendetta is:

"Only usable when you are successfully bled for more than 2 pool.
Put this card on the acting minion. Brujah antitribu get +1 strength in
combat with the minion with this card. Any ready Brujah antitribu may
enter combat with this vampire as a (D) action. Burn this card if this
minion goes to torpor."

Is the use of "vampire" there an error? It seems unlikely that it was
intended to only allow the rush if the bleeding minion was a vampire,
but apply all the other effects even if it was an ally.

Josh

some day... and that day may never come...
